chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Aban ibn Abd al-Malik ibn Karram al-Khath'ami, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

One who recites 'When the victory of Allah has come' in a recommended or obligatory prayer, Allah will grant him victory over all his enemies. On the Day of Judgment, he will come with a talking book that Allah has brought forth from his chest, containing protection from the bridge of Hell, from the Fire, and from the roaring of Hell. Nothing on the Day of Judgment will pass by him except that it will give him glad tidings and inform him of all good, until he enters Paradise. And for him in this world, doors of goodness will be opened that he never imagined or conceived in his heart.

key_terms.إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ: When the victory of Allah has come (Surah Al-Nasr)

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and worldly rewards for reciting Surah Al-Nasr in prayer?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to emphasize the spiritual efficacy of Surah Al-Nasr, linking its theme of divine victory to both worldly success and eschatological security. The unique detail of the book of deeds 'speaking' reflects the Shia belief in the tangible reality of the Hereafter, while the promise of unexpected worldly blessings underscores the holistic nature of divine favor for the faithful.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Aban b. Abd al-Malik b. Karram al-Khath’ami from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:

“One who recites Surah Nasr in his obligatory or recommended prayers Allah will give him conquest over all enemies and he will have a talking book with him on the Day of Judgment. He will have protection against the bridge, fire and fiery voices of Hell when Allah resurrects him from grave. Every person meeting him will congratulate and give him glad tidings till he enters Paradise. A number of doors of goodness will be opened for him in this world so much that he would never have imagined or desired.”
